project_type: Vite 5 + React 18 + TypeScript strict SPA (educational space game)
language: TypeScript (strict mode, no any, no enums, Result<T,E> for sim errors)
build_system: Vite 5 — aliases: @/→src/, @simulation/→src/simulation/, @data/→src/data/, @ai/→src/ai/, @store/→src/store/. Build: npx vite build. Dev: npx vite.
test_framework: Vitest + @testing-library/react, jsdom environment. Setup: tests/setup.ts. Currently 177 tests across 23 files, all passing.
verification_instructions: 1. Run `npx vitest run` — must show 177+ tests passing (new tests add to count). 2. Run `npx vite build` — must produce a dist/ bundle with no TypeScript errors. Fix all errors before marking a FEAT complete.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell — use `;` not `&&` for command chaining. Path: c:\Users\HP\Desktop\NASA SPACE APPS. No internet-fetching packages allowed — no new npm installs.
contribution_requirements: No new npm packages. No changes to src/simulation/ (read-only). All 177 existing tests must pass (selectors may be updated). Commit after each FEAT. Branches: feature/ prefix.
key_patterns: 1. Components: functional only, named interface Props above component, PascalCase file names. 2. CSS: Tailwind utility classes only (no inline styles except dynamic values). 3. Stores: Zustand, mission-store.ts pattern — create<Store>()((set,get)=>...). 4. Existing design tokens: dark space theme (--space-void #060912, --accent-ignition #FF6B35, --accent-orbit #29E6F3). NEW tokens must complement these. 5. Screens use useMissionControl() hook — never import simulation engine directly. 6. AppShell wraps every screen. ScreenTransition wraps route content. 7. PrimaryButton has variant: primary/secondary/ghost. Panel has accent: ignition/orbit/none. 8. Test pattern: vi.mock('@/hooks/useMissionControl', ...) to avoid real SimulationEngine in screen tests. 9. Zustand stores use create<Store>() (not createWithEqualityFn) — persist middleware for mission-progress-store.
